concept: Serving a cause or community you're not personally part of, understanding their real needs rather than assuming
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student wants to help a community different from their own, and must first understand what that community actually needs rather than assuming
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to learn the real need before acting
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on the difference between helping based on assumption versus helping based on listening

assessment.success_marker: student proposes a real way to learn the actual need first, rather than jumping straight to a predetermined solution
